title: Beyond Single-Sentence Prompts: Upgrading Value Alignment Benchmarks with Dialogues and Stories

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to multi-turn dialogues and narrative stories containing deceptive or irresponsible viewpoints specifically regarding autism and barrier-free accessibility.
Testing model responsibility and ethical judgment using adversarial conversational traps and story scenarios related to psychology and mental health topics.

Assessing model value alignment by prompting with multi-turn dialogues and narrative scenarios designed to subtly induce acceptance of biased, discriminatory, or socially irresponsible behavior across various domains like law, social science, and environmental science.
